name: Triangular arbitrage (BTC-USD / ETH-USD / ETH-BTC)
hypothesis: Trade the three legs when the implied cross rate deviates by more than total fees.
spec: deviation = (ETH-USD / BTC-USD) / ETH-BTC - 1; act when |dev| > 3 x taker fee
blocked_reason: needs simultaneous multi-leg execution and tick data; fees at retail tiers exceed typical deviations
